title: PlagiaCorpus: A Bilingual, Adversarial, and Cross-Lingual Dataset for Forensic Plagiarism Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.02940v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: PlagiaCorpus is a bilingual Arabic-English dataset for benchmarking plagiarism and text-reuse detection, including reuse produced by large language models (LLMs) and reuse across languages. It contains 198,643 text records: a source corpus of 34,885 passages drawn from English and Arabic Wikipedia and two openly licensed book collections, and 163,758 queries (147,381 for training and 16,377 for testing). The queries cover five reuse classes of increasing difficulty, namely verbatim copying, character-level obfuscation, same-language paraphrasing by two different LLMs, and English--Arabic translation with structural paraphrasing, together with a Safe class of non-reused passages. Every positive query is linked to its source passage, and the train/test split is grouped by source passage so that no passage contributes queries to both splits. translated_title: PlagiaCorpus：用于取证式抄袭检测的双语、对抗性、跨语言数据集
translated_abstract: PlagiaCorpus 是一个阿拉伯语-英语双语数据集，用于对抄袭与文本复用检测进行基准测试，涵盖由大语言模型（LLM）产生的复用以及跨语言的复用。该数据集包含 198,643 条文本记录：一个由 34,885 个段落组成的源语料库（取自英文和阿拉伯文维基百科以及两个开放许可的图书集），以及 163,758 个查询（其中 147,381 个用于训练，16,377 个用于测试）。查询涵盖五种难度递增的复用类别，即逐字复制、字符级混淆、由两个不同 LLM 进行的同语言改写、以及英阿翻译加结构性改写，此外还包括一个由非复用文本组成的 Safe（安全）类别。每个正例查询都与其源段落相关联，并且训练/测试集的划分按源段落分组，从而确保没有任何段落同时向两个划分贡献查询。该数据集的发布经过了语言识别、去除 LLM 生成痕迹以及……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文发布了 PlagiaCorpus——一个包含近 20 万条记录的阿拉伯语-英语双语数据集，通过逐字复制、字符级混淆、LLM 改写及跨语言翻译改写等五种难度递增的对抗性复用场景，为取证式抄袭与文本复用检测提供了系统性评测基准。
en_tdlr: PlagiaCorpus introduces a bilingual Arabic-English benchmark of nearly 200K records featuring five increasingly difficult adversarial reuse classes—including verbatim copying, character-level obfuscation, LLM paraphrasing, and cross-lingual translation—to systematically evaluate forensic plagiarism and text-reuse detection.
